SYNTHETIC_INPUTS.refusal: B1 (33rd admission refused before read) + DA3 (33/NaN refused)
SYNTHETIC_INPUTS.censusUnit: admittedCount is a separate unit from scannedPayloadCount (DA-1)

SCANNED_BYTES.refusal: B2 (second input refused before read) + DA3 (67108865/NaN refused)
SCANNED_BYTES.note: reservation BEFORE read using verified size; refund on parse failure (CX4); P3-4: containerReadBytes is charged from the stat size before a RAW admission refusal — pre-existing disclosed limitation (R2-4), unchanged

LAYOUT_EVALUATIONS.joinTwoInputs: B3 (cap 3000 stops the second input mid-analysis)
LAYOUT_EVALUATIONS.counterSemantics: layoutAttempts = REQUESTS including the refused one (61 at limit 60 = 60 executed + 1 refused, layoutRefusals=1); never described as 61 performed evaluations

FULL_CENSUS_ROWS.refusal: B4 (cap 160 -> honest PARTIAL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED) + PA1 no-budget control (fullCensusRows 100)
FULL_CENSUS_ROWS.joinTwoInputs: B4 (two inputs share the finalist census budget)
FULL_CENSUS_ROWS.mandatoryTarget: PA-1 target receives the legal budget of exactly 4800 rows -> FULL_CENSUS 4800

RETAINED_CANDIDATES.refusal: B5 (cap 4 -> honest PARTIAL with candidates retained) + DA2_MUTANT_COPY (forced copy detected by the identity observer)
RETAINED_CANDIDATES.joinTwoInputs: B5 + DA2_CAP4 (2 inputs) + DA2_CAP256 (9 inputs; both inputs actually deliver records — object identities measured, not the tracker)

distinctRecordAccounting.rule: MAX_RETAINED_CANDIDATES bounds simultaneously live DISTINCT candidate records across found/per-call candidate lists and allRows
distinctRecordAccounting.aliasing: the forwarded row IS the candidate object — the same object in two arrays counts ONCE; new objects with the same fields count SEPARATELY
distinctRecordAccounting.notRecords: CSV/JSON text, indexes, configuration and per-axis statistics are not candidate records
distinctRecordAccounting.oracle: Set-of-identities observer over the actual holding collections; the production peakRetained tracker is recorded but is NOT the oracle; no GC-based proof

exhaustionSemantics.containerDirectoryCost: containerReadBytes is a separate unit from SCANNED_BYTES
exhaustionSemantics.exhaustionIsNeverNoCandidate: BUDGET_EXHAUSTED + COVERAGE=PARTIAL with retained candidates kept (B5/DA2_CAP4)
exhaustionSemantics.noReadAfterExhaustion: payloads that cannot be analyzed are not readEntry-decoded after the shared LAYOUT budget is exhausted

invocations.note: in-process controls (DA3 refusals/positives, PA1 truth+production, aggregator controls) are recorded per case in POST_TEST_RESULTS.json

honestNote: the corrected tool needed no fix after its first green full-suite run; implementation bring-up iterations and POST/QC harness bugs are disclosed in AMENDMENT_LOG.md
